blocks.text: Every barkada has its own version of a perfect weekend getaway. There is the friend who wants to squeeze a workout into their schedule before breakfast, the one who is always game to try a new activity, and one who would rather spend the afternoon exploring restaurants and shops rather than breaking a sweat. Getting everyone to agree on a destination is one thing. Finding somewhere that accommodates all those preferences is another. Picturesque Subic Bay, in Zambales, offers a happy middle ground for all three friends. Accessible by road from Metro Manila, the Freeport is a convenient option for a […]...
